name: Moonshae Isles
title: The Nordic Archipelago: Moonshae Isles
description: These cold, rocky isles form a mystical archipelago to the west of the Sword Coast, where the Ffolk and Northlanders share a tenuous peace under the watchful eye of the Earthmother.
wiki: The Moonshaes are a land of mist and magic. Its islands, like Alaron and Gwynneth, are home to ancient druidic traditions and deep-seated conflicts between the native Ffolk and the raiding Northlanders. The islands are teeming with fey spirits and ancient standing stones, making it a sacred place for those who revere nature.

metadata.landscape: Mist-shrouded hills, dark forests, rugged cliffs
